eps.ov: Kimio and Nozomi meets the shy Yuuki Makino, who complexes about her own body. Together they team up to help Makino break out of shell.
A ghost is haunting the girls’ swim team, and it’s up to Nozomi and Kimio to investigate! Kimio, however, wants nothing to do with this.
Sonoda is not happy when Nozomi beats her in a popularity contest.
